event: You will fire down into your arms, back and legs instead of out of your hand.

memory.fact: Fire worked into her body is a Surge working that lends strength; at Flare she hauls like two men.

event: Heat floods your muscles like fever sweat, but doesn't burn; you feel strong as two men.

changes.note: Her first minute of fire-strength costs a Surge's 10 mana

memory.fact: Fire-strength runs hot through her like fever sweat, but never burns her.

event: You wade into the wallow, take the old boar by both tusks, and heave; he slides a foot.

changes.note: A heave at the sunk boar costs her 1 stamina

memory.fact: An old Grubboar weighs as much as four grown men.

event: The mud holds him. You heave again, feet skidding, renewing the fire each minute.

changes.note: Two more minutes of held fire-strength cost 20 mana

memory.fact: Holding fire-strength, she feels a hot pull behind her breastbone each minute she renews it.

event: On the third heave the tusks turn slick in your grip, and you sit down hard.
The boar rolls and settles deeper, sunk to his shoulders, his tusks under the brown water.

memory.fact: The old boar's carcass sank to its shoulders in the wallow, its tusks under water and out of reach.
The old boar's carcass sank deep in the swamp muck where Nala killed it; she got only the tusks out.

event: You let the fire go; the heat drains away and leaves your arms trembling.

memory.fact: When she lets fire-strength go, the heat drains away and leaves her arms trembling.

event: Waist-deep beside the carcass, you check your mana: about eight minutes of fire-strength left.
You lift a thin disc of water from the wallow and set it spinning fast above your palm.
You bring it down on the boar's neck behind the jaw; it grinds through bristle and hide.

memory.fact: A spinning water disc held against a beast saws through hide and bone like a blade.

event: Twice it skips off a sunken tusk and throws muck in your face; you renew it each minute.
In the third minute it grinds through the neck bone, and the head comes free.

changes.note: Three minutes of water disc on the boar's neck, less what came back

event: You hug the head, heavy as a grown man, up the bank and into the alders.

memory.fact: An old Grubboar's head alone weighs about as much as a grown man.

event: Within fifty yards your arms burn; you drop it and drag it by a tusk instead.

changes.note: Hauling the boar's head into the carr costs her 2 stamina

event: Roots catch it; you heave it free again and again, feet sliding in black leaf mould.
Your arms cramp and you go down on your knees; you've come a few hundred yards at most.

memory.fact: Nala sawed off the old boar's head and dragged it a few hundred yards into the alder carr.

event: You call the water disc up again, thinner and faster, until it's a hissing blur.

memory.fact: Willed thinner and faster, a water disc cuts in about half the time, at the same cost.

event: It sinks into the jaw almost without a sound; one tusk drops, then you take the second.

changes.note: A minute of fast water disc takes both tusks for 10 mana

memory.fact: Nala cut both tusks off the old boar's head with a thin, fast water disc.
Cutting off both tusks with a fast water disc is an easy act, held one minute.

event: Both tusks lie in the leaf mould, yellow and curved, each as long as your forearm.

memory.fact: An old boar's tusks are yellow and forearm-long; a fast water disc takes each off in under a minute.
An old boar's two tusks together weigh a few pounds, easily carried.

event: A tusk in each hand, you set off north through the alder carr to the torn, empty oat strips.
Some twenty minutes on you reach the south palisade, muddy and bloodied to the elbows.

memory.fact: The walk from where Nala left the boar's head to the south palisade takes some twenty minutes.

event: The green is quiet; in the Stag Garrick sweeps, and Agathe sits at the long table with her tallies.

memory.fact: Mornings the green is quiet: folk are at the reed beds, charcoal mounds and oat strips.
Mornings she keeps the tallies at the Stag's long table while the village is out at work.
Mornings he is in the Stag's hall, sweeping and brewing, with the reeve at her tallies.

event: Garrick stops sweeping and stares; you lay the tusks on the table before the reeve.
Agathe turns one over: "The old boar. The one rooting our oats."

memory.fact: The old boar's tusks alone are proof enough for her to pay its bounty.

event: She unlocks the chest and counts five silver coins out onto the table.

changes.note: Agathe pays the old boar's bounty, five silver

memory.fact: She pays the boar bounty as five silver coins from the chest, and sends a cart for the carcass.

event: "The hide and meat are yours. I'll send a cart; I'd buy the meat for the village at two silver."

changes.note: Her mana comes back over the walk to the village

memory.fact: The boar's hide and meat are Nala's; she'd buy the meat for the village at two silver.
